ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the world local-region map and the statistical charts of temperature and precipitation data for Ankara and Beirut, and complete the blank: <image1> The occurrence of the climate feature selected in the previous question is not affected by _____.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the regional map on the left shows that Ankara is located in the inland area of Turkey, and Beirut is located on the eastern coast of the Mediterranean Sea, in a coastal location. In the temperature and precipitation statistical charts on the right, the precipitation bars of Ankara and Beirut both show the characteristics of relatively more precipitation in winter and obviously less in summer, while the temperature curves are higher in summer. Reasoning: the climate feature selected in the previous question can be understood as the Mediterranean climate's “winter rain and summer dryness” or “rain and heat not in the same period.” This feature is mainly caused by the seasonal movement of pressure belts and wind belts; Ankara is relatively inland and Beirut is coastal, but both have the common feature of less rain in summer and more rain in winter, showing that the occurrence of this feature is not affected by land-sea location. Land-sea location mainly affects the amount of precipitation and the annual temperature range.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the world local-region map and the statistical charts of temperature and precipitation data for Ankara and Beirut, and complete the blank:

<image1>

The occurrence of the climate feature selected in the previous question is not affected by _____.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读取安卡拉和贝鲁特的位置及气候统计图：一个偏内陆、一个临海，但二者降水柱状图都表现出夏季少雨、冬季相对多雨的共同特征。再结合题干“上题所选气候特征的出现不受____影响”，把该特征理解为地中海气候的雨热不同期/冬雨夏干。依据地理知识判断此特征主要由气压带、风带的季节移动造成，而不是由海陆位置决定；海陆位置只会影响降水多少和气温年较差。因此填“海陆位置”。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：左侧区域图显示安卡拉位于土耳其内陆地区，贝鲁特位于地中海东岸、临海位置。右侧气温和降水统计图中，安卡拉与贝鲁特的降水柱都表现出冬季相对较多、夏季明显较少的特点，气温曲线则在夏季较高。推理：上题所选气候特征可理解为地中海气候的“冬雨夏干”或“雨热不同期”。这种特征主要由气压带、风带的季节移动造成；安卡拉偏内陆、贝鲁特临海，但二者都出现夏季少雨、冬季多雨的共同特征，说明该特征的出现不受海陆位置影响。海陆位置主要影响降水多少和气温年较差。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 图像描述：左侧区域图显示安卡拉位于土耳其内陆地区，贝鲁特位于地中海东岸、临海位置。右侧气温和降水统计图中，安卡拉与贝鲁特的降水柱都表现出冬季相对较多、夏季明显较少的特点，气温曲线则在夏季较高。推理：上题所选气候特征可理解为地中海气候的“冬雨夏干”或“雨热不同期”。这种特征主要由气压带、风带的季节移动造成；安卡拉偏内陆、贝鲁特临海，但二者都出现夏季少雨、冬季多雨的共同特征，说明该特征的出现不受海陆位置影响。海陆位置主要影响降水多少和气温年较差。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 该推理 trace 与题目、图像和标准答案一致。图像描述先于推理，符合“先描述图像，再推理”的要求；关于安卡拉偏内陆、贝鲁特临海以及两地降水均呈夏季少雨、冬季相对多雨的概括可由图中位置和气候统计图支持。推理也基本按照方法草稿：由共同的地中海气候特征推出其成因主要是气压带、风带季节移动，而非海陆位置，最终答案与标准答案“海陆位置”一致。若要更严谨，可把安卡拉降水表述为“夏季明显偏少、冷季或春季相对较多”，避免过度强调严格冬季最多。
method.CoT_final: 图像描述：左侧区域图显示安卡拉位于土耳其内陆地区，贝鲁特位于地中海东岸、临海位置。右侧气温和降水统计图中，安卡拉与贝鲁特的降水柱都表现出冬季相对较多、夏季明显较少的特点，气温曲线则在夏季较高。推理：上题所选气候特征可理解为地中海气候的“冬雨夏干”或“雨热不同期”。这种特征主要由气压带、风带的季节移动造成；安卡拉偏内陆、贝鲁特临海，但二者都出现夏季少雨、冬季多雨的共同特征，说明该特征的出现不受海陆位置影响。海陆位置主要影响降水多少和气温年较差。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct causal-factor route: it first identifies the shared climate feature from the two climographs, then matches that feature to its standard atmospheric-circulation cause and excludes the non-causal factor.
planner_metadata.image_role: Use the map to note the two stations: 安卡拉 is inland in Turkey while 贝鲁特 is on the eastern Mediterranean coast; use the two climate charts to observe that both have precipitation concentrated in the cooler/winter months and very little precipitation in summer, despite different total rainfall amounts.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read the prompt as asking for the factor that does not affect the occurrence of the previously selected climate characteristic, requiring a short fill-in answer.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply the rule for Mediterranean-type winter-rain/summer-dry climates: the seasonal alternation of subtropical high pressure in summer and westerlies in winter produces the feature. Sea-land position mainly modifies moisture amount and continentality, but it is not the fundamental factor controlling the occurrence of this seasonal rainfall pattern.
